text: Please draft a short mail to Hollis Mbeki with the Quarrendon Freight Lines proposed 2027 per-seat rate for the territory review. reply_text: The proposed text is above. I haven’t saved the mail draft: sharing a per-seat rate with Hollis requires June’s or Anselm’s approval, even when you own the account. I’ve recorded the approval request for June here.

text: I will be on the road tomorrow morning, reachable on mobile.
